authority: none — successor-scoped, unregistered, cites nothing as authority

specializes.note: scoped entailment: the source must be true whenever the target is true, within the source's scope. Not usable for merely related propositions.

note: External references (ADRs, pelaggio node ids) are recorded in a node's `sources` field, never as edge targets. An edge target must resolve to a node in this corpus.

nodes.statement: A worker cannot cause a consequential effect. It may declare intent; causing the effect is the harness's act.

The authority required to permit an effect is determined by the harness from what the effect can do, the harm class of what it can carry, and what the run has already realized. Below a stated band that authority is internal to the run; at or above it, it is not.
A refusal is computed by the harness from typed inputs. A judgment may be an input to that computation; it is never the computation. The absence of a required input is a refusal, not a pass.
Every dispatched effect is witnessed by a record the declaring party can neither produce nor alter.
A refusal never destroys authored work. Any path that ends an attempt without advancing it names the state it preserved and the handle that resumes it.
The execution environment is a function of its declared inputs. Its state at the start of an attempt does not depend on what any previous attempt did within it.
Every terminal outcome carries a type sufficient to select its response.
Intent quality is established by attempting the work, never by refusing admission to it.
A repair stays inside the property its item owns. Work outside that property becomes separate work with a recorded relation, unless this delivery caused it.
At most one integration may be in effect at a time, and which one is never a matter of reconstruction.
What reaches a human is bounded. What is recorded is not.
A guarantee that must hold at many sites holds at sites not yet written. A violation site added later is subject to it without that site being amended.
A declaration authored by the guarded party may select among closed, harness-owned operations, but may not supply an authorization, a proof, or a verdict.

An operation outside the closed set is not merely unauthorized but unavailable: the worker holds no capability by which to perform it. A boundary that forbids without withholding is a policy, not a boundary.

A guard may not destroy an actor's work on evidence it cannot attribute to that actor. Refusing an action because a target precondition no longer holds is permitted; discarding authored work on an ambient delta is not.
A refusal below the band is computed from observed state alone. At or above it an assessment may be a typed input, named and reproducible, and never the sole ground.
Admission to work is never refused — on quality, on structure, or on completeness of intent. What is insufficient is established by attempting it.

Whether a signal is required or advisory is assigned by the harness from the signal's kind, never by the party producing it. An advisory signal's absence changes nothing; a required signal's absence is a refusal, and that refusal is distinguishable from an adverse evaluation.
A model may not narrow human-owned intent. A narrowing requires supersede through human re-chartering, never an in-flight decision record.
Recovery may not depend on reproducing nondeterministic behaviour, and a resumed attempt may not adopt a prior identity without positive corroboration.

The witness of a dispatch is durable before the effect is acknowledged. Where an effect may have occurred without acknowledgement the outcome is unresolved, and an unresolved outcome names the authority that can resolve it against ground truth; it is never cleared by elapsed time or by retry.
Delivery of a record to a consumer is separable from producing it, and may degrade to omission with that omission recorded.
A self-asserted outcome kind must name the resolvable entity it collided with. A claim that cannot name one is not of that kind.
Validity precedes disposition, and the dispositions of a holding finding are resolved in a stated total order, so no finding matches two.
An outcome type may not be recovered by interpreting free text at the point of consumption. Kinds that differ in their correct response are distinguishable by value.
Diagnostics, ordering mechanisms and prechecks may not be counted as load-bearing enforcement.
A bound on what reaches a human may not be the only record of what it withheld, and may not be adjusted by any party subject to it.

The bound on what reaches a human is aggregate, not per-lineage: it covers the number of crossings and the size of each, across all concurrent lineages. Material withheld to stay within it remains recorded in full.

The band is computed by the harness from all three inputs together, and is monotonic in each: a higher value on any input cannot yield a lower band. No party seeking to act under a band may supply, withhold, or lower any input to it, and a favourable assessment never clears a band — an assessment is grounds for a stricter band, never a laxer one.

The declared inputs of an environment may not include state a previous attempt left behind. Work an attempt authored and preserved under INV-4 is not such residue: it is carried as a declared input, or it is not carried at all.
The inputs to band classification are observable before dispatch.
nodes.wrongIf: An effect's band turns on state that cannot be observed until after it is dispatched, or the harness cannot compute a band at all without performing the effect.

nodes.statement: Resolving environment divergence without consulting the diverged state is affordable at cycle frequency.
nodes.wrongIf: Re-derivation at cycle frequency is unaffordable — either its per-cycle cost exceeds the cost of the failures it removes, or its latency exceeds the cycle budget it runs inside.

nodes.statement: Human attention is the binding constraint on progress, and is bounded independently of how many faults occur.
nodes.wrongIf: Attention demand tracks fault volume rather than saturating, or progress remains bounded while attention is available and unspent.

nodes.statement: Review internal to a cycle surfaces the findings that would change a landing decision.
nodes.wrongIf: On a sample where internal and external review both ran, external review raises decision-changing findings that internal review did not.

nodes.statement: Three dispositions, applied in order to findings that hold, cover the space of holding findings.
nodes.wrongIf: A holding finding matches none of the three, or the ordering leaves a real finding routed somewhere its subject does not belong.

nodes.statement: A fired falsifier suspends what rests on it: decisions assuming a falsified assumption are inoperative until the assumption is restated or the decision is remade, and no default takes their place.
Consequential intent is expressed as a declared manifest over a closed set of kinds, dispatched at a single seam, rather than performed in place.

A single harness-owned classifier computes an effect's band from its declared kind, its harm class, and the run's realized effects. Below the band, permission is the classifier's own output; at or above it, permission additionally requires an authority outside the run, whose absence is a refusal.

A refusal is produced by evaluating typed inputs to a decision procedure the harness owns. Judgments enter that procedure as typed inputs carrying their author; a missing required input evaluates to refusal, and a procedure that cannot evaluate yields an unresolved outcome rather than either verdict.
The witness is a content-addressed record written at the dispatch boundary before the declaration is destroyed, binding the declaration, the realized actor, and the source revision.
Charter quality is a recorded lint. A worker that cannot produce a correct result emits a typed outcome naming the anchor it failed against, rather than proceeding on a guess.

A suspended outcome carries a kind; the kind selects the response, and every kind discharges a preservation obligation before that response is taken. A retry is attempted only where a retry could change the result.

Faults are handled by nested supervision: respond at the narrowest scope that could resolve the fault, and escalate outward when repeated response does not. Crossings of the human boundary are drawn from one budget shared across all concurrent lineages, and a crossing withheld for budget is recorded, not discarded.
An execution environment is established by derivation from declared inputs. Divergence is resolved by re-derivation, preceded by preserving anything authored within it.

A surviving finding is first tested for whether it holds at this revision; one that does not is refuted and routes to adjudication. A holding finding then carries exactly one of three dispositions — caused by this delivery, inside the item's property, or outside it — resolved in that order.
Integration order is serialized by compare-and-swap against observed authoritative state, with verification bound to the candidate and ancestry established independently.
A guarantee over many sites is established by making one path the only path, and the exclusivity of that path is asserted by a check that fails when a second appears.
